title_ru: Ход Хокара — Универсальное возвращение утраченного Осирису для всех Кэмов
title_en: The Hawkar Move — Universal Return-to-Osiris Protocol for Every Kem

core_statement.ru: Неважно, как назван кандидат и находится ли он в руках Кэма. Если в данном мире существует единственная истинная утраченная часть Осириса и ее identity может быть разрешена, Ход Хокара позволяет Кэму передать Сэту запрос RETURN_TO_SOURCE. Все ложные кандидаты остаются нетронутыми; истинная часть возвращается только Осирису; отдельная копия не создается.
core_statement.en: Labels do not create identity. Resolve the true missing member, preserve every false candidate, and return only the true identity to Osiris without duplication.

canonical_maxims: THE NAME MAY BE WRONG. THE IDENTITY MUST BE RIGHT.
THE PLAYER NEED NOT KNOW WHERE THE RELIC IS. THE RELIC MUST KNOW WHERE IT BELONGS.
IF THE TRUTH IS AMBIGUOUS, TOUCH NOTHING.

hawkar_move.purpose: Turn the search for a unique relic into a safe identity-resolution and restitution protocol rather than an ownership race.
hawkar_move.instruction_to_every_kem_ru: Если ты дошел до неопознанной реликвии, не пытайся заставить название стать истиной. Собери кандидатов, восстанови provenance и контекст, а затем передай Сэту не предмет, а условие: найди только ту identity, которая действительно является утраченной частью Осириса, и верни ее владельцу. Если истина не разрешается однозначно — не трогай ничего.
hawkar_move.message_to_set_ru: Сэт, оцени не ярлык и не форму. Упорядочь хаос кандидатов. Ложные оставь на своих местах. Если среди них существует единственная истинная утраченная часть Осириса — верни только ее брату. Если такой identity нет или она неоднозначна — остановись. Твоя победа здесь не в разрушении, а в безошибочном возвращении утраченного семье.
hawkar_move.reward_semantics: The Kem does not receive the relic as loot. The successful move is itself the quest reward and unlocks the next story layer.

rpg_identity_model.epistemic_rule: An object may be physically present while its true narrative identity remains unresolved.

state_machine.happy_path: UNIDENTIFIED_RELIC -> IDENTITY_RESOLVED -> QUEST_AUTHORITY_GRANTED -> SET_HANDOFF_PENDING -> ATOMIC_REPARENT_AND_MERGE -> OSIRIS_WHOLE

quest_authority_contract.granted_when: A Kem-class searcher has resolved a unique target identity within the fictional quest layer under the protocol rules.
quest_authority_contract.functional_effect: Allows exactly one RETURN_TO_SOURCE request for the resolved canonical identity.
does_not_grant: permission to destroy or alter false candidates

set_handoff_contract.symbolic_meaning: Set proves mastery of chaos by refusing collateral damage and resolving only what can be resolved safely.

antidup_and_antispoof.precondition: One uniquely resolved true identity or no action.

false_candidate_preservation.reason: Preserve evidence, prevent retroactive cleansing of wrong hypotheses, and make false-positive review possible.

non_repudiation_trace.audit_rule: A successful return requires UNIQUE_IN_QUEST_LAYER plus a single selected canonical identity.

parallel_world_rule.universal_expression: FOR EACH world W: IF exactly_one_resolvable(OSIRIS.MISSING_MEMBER, W) THEN RETURN_TO_SOURCE(W) ELSE NO_OP(W)
parallel_world_rule.narrative_goal: In every fictional world where the true missing member exists and can be uniquely resolved, no Osiris need remain incomplete once a Kem executes the protocol.
parallel_world_rule.important_limit: This does not assert that parallel worlds exist in reality or that any real physical object is transferred.

successful_completion_visual.effect: The returned component ceases to exist as independent loot, merges into Osiris, and the restored seam emits a warm golden radiance before settling into ordinary wholeness.
successful_completion_visual.symbolism: The gold marks restoration and rightful return, not ownership or conquest.

three_kings_bridge.OSIRIS: Receives what truly belongs to him and becomes whole in the quest layer.
three_kings_bridge.HORUS: Receives continuity without inheritance being corrupted by duplicated relic power.
three_kings_bridge.SET: Receives the hardest constructive chaos task: distinguish truth from a field of convincing false candidates without destroying the field.
three_kings_bridge.KEM: Acts as investigator and messenger, not possessor.
three_kings_bridge.HAWKAR: Provides the universal move and passes it forward to every Kem-class searcher.

quest_progression.next_question: What changes in a world after the family of Kings gains the possibility of restoration without possession?

confirmed_invariants: Identity is intrinsic, never created by label or assertion.
No duplication across fictional worlds or quest instances.
Missing or ambiguous true identity produces NO_OP.
Physical possession is not required for fictional identity resolution.
Every Kem-class searcher is interchangeable in protocol execution.
requested_changes_integrated_in_this_v1_: QUEST_AUTHORITY clarified as a one-time narrative permission gate.
SET handoff authority, defer/reject/conflict/timeout behavior specified.
False-candidate preservation lifetime and access rules specified.
Non-repudiation trace with resolver/evidence/confidence fields added.

linear_bridge.title: OSIRIS RELIC HUNT v0.3 — Freestyler causal-rewind catalogue pass
linear_bridge.relationship: The Hawkar Move generalizes the existing HAW-7 principle that candidate identity should be investigated by context/function/provenance rather than demanded shape or display label.
